title: Sentic
description: This mod is designed to help and will do the commands for you but it only works if you have op. The assistant is launched using the K key.
body:
Sentic is a utility for server administrators that integrates Large Language Models into the Minecraft environment. It allows users with appropriate permissions to manage the server through natural language processing.

Key Functionality:

Natural Language Interpretation: The mod captures text input from a private interface and utilizes an external AI engine to translate human intent into executable Minecraft commands.

Contextual Data Processing: Before processing a request, the mod gathers environmental metadata, including nearby entities, player coordinates, and world states, to provide the AI with the necessary context for precise command generation.

Silent Command Execution: Commands are executed on behalf of the player using automated network packets. The mod intercepts and suppresses standard command feedback to ensure that administrative actions remain invisible to other players on the server.

Secure Access Control: Access to the AI interface and its command execution capabilities is strictly restricted to players with Operator Level 4. The mod performs client-side permission checks before initializing any external API calls.

Custom Terminal Interface: A dedicated, non-intrusive GUI provides a workspace for inputting requests and receiving status updates from the AI assistant without using the standard game chat.
